name: Trae (ByteDance)
invoke: reference the waypost-<role> rule, or paste `waypost agents show <role>` into a new chat

skills.notes: The docs page renders client-side and could not be fetched; the path is the indexed text of that page (project skills are created in `.trae/skills/<name>`).

notes: Documented for Trae is ONE project rules file: .trae/rules/project_rules.md. Whether additional files in that directory are loaded is not documented, so the roles are written beside it and the routing block goes into project_rules.md — that part is certain. If your Trae ignores the extra files, invoke a role with `waypost agents show <role>` instead. (The separate open-source bytedance/trae-agent CLI is a different tool with a trae_config.yaml and no role files.) project_rules.md is the documented location; AGENTS.md support is not established.
